verdict.rationale: Shared collaborative editing is a fair question for a note-taking and knowledge-management app, so the axis applies. The only sharing evidence is the pricing line about granting others view-only access to notes. That is an adjacent feature, not shared editing of a space. Cross-device sync and offline sync cover a single user's devices, not multi-user co-editing or conflict handling.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can share a vault or space with collaborators and edit notes together without stepping on each other's changes

citations.quote: Grant others view-only access to notes
